* For speakers of other languages just ask on the [http://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/lojban-beginners Lojban mailing list] or via [lojban-beginners@googlegroups.com email].

* See also the [[ongoing projects|ongoing projects list]] on the Wiki for some LLG-independent translation projects people are working on.
